configurations.name: gallery
runtimeArgs:
import sys
sys.path.pop(0)                       # startup cwd may be unreadable; keep it off sys.path
import os, http.server
import mimetypes
mimetypes.add_type('image/avif','.avif')
mimetypes.add_type('image/webp','.webp')
MIRROR = '/private/tmp/photography-portfolio-preview'
SRC = '/Users/keithmerkelt/Documents/Websites/photography portfolio'
# This app's preview process is denied reads under ~/Documents by macOS
# (Privacy > Files and Folders > Documents). Serve the mirror when one exists.
os.chdir(MIRROR if os.path.isdir(MIRROR) else SRC)
print('serving', os.getcwd())
http.server.test(HandlerClass=http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, port=8765, bind='127.0.0.1')
